verdict.description: pass: ready for the admin. revise: only words need changing (caption, alt text, a slide's words). hold: anything words cannot fix.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences for the admin: what the post is, and the verdict's reason.

checks.description: One entry per check, each exactly once.

note.description: What you checked and what you found, briefly.

notes.description: Every change needed. Empty on pass.

target.description: slide_text: the words on a slide (the revision turn fixes them). slide: anything else on a slide (its picture, source line or layout), which needs a person.

slide.description: 1-based slide number, when the note is about one slide or its alt text.

fix.description: The change you would make; null if it needs a person.
